checks.text: Chapters 1 to 5 build on each other: first one basic sentence, then where things are, then how many there are, then when something happens, and then how long it takes. checks.text: ### 10.24 Which verb goes with which noun (extra lesson)

The new verbs in this chapter each have a few nouns they like to go with, and learning them in pairs makes the sentences come quicker. Most take their noun with o. Two are different: wakaru takes what you understand with ga, as in nihongo ga wakaru, and shiru is mostly used in the negative, as in ana san o shiranai (I don't know Ana).

checks.text: A short conversation for reading practice. Kim tells Ben about a new computer, and Ben asks where it came from and how much it cost. The price uses gurai (about) after the amount, as in 3.5. A few words come from later chapters: kaimashita (bought) is in Chapter 8, atarashii (new) and mise (shop) are in Chapter 6, and the ending yo, which adds emphasis, is in Chapter 9.
